_help: Government extensions for the website's compliance calendar. 'extensions' moves a built-in date (match by id, e.g. soc-itr-2026, tds-q3-2027, gst-r9-2026, chs-agm-2027). 'extra' adds a one-off date (cat: CHS, TDS, GST or SOC). 'hide' removes a built-in date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Update 'updated' whenever you check.

extensions.note: CBDT extended the due date for audit cases for AY 2026-27 (FY 2025-26).
